drivers: Simple +1 count progression across rows is easy to spot and immediately eliminates half the options
All shapes solid, so empty-outline distractors are quickly discarded
Shape identity follows a 3-item cycle (circle→pentagon→arrow→circle) that must be inferred from row 2; the 5-solid-pentagons distractor catches those who miss the cycle
Generous 75 s limit and no rotation/fill variation keep working-memory load low
